name: record_hypothesis
arguments: {"statement": "The Thr45Met substitution sits in the WH1/EVH1 domain and removes a contact needed for WASp to bind its partner WIP, weakening the WASp\u2013WIP complex and the downstream proline-rich-ligand recognition that depends on it.", "mechanism_class": "protein_interaction", "supports": ["E5", "E6", "E16", "E10", "E15", "E7", "E9"], "would_refute": "If residue 45 is solvent-exposed and more than about 10 \u00c5 from the WIP-binding surface in PDB 9S9X and in a WASp\u2013WIP model, and the Met substitution does not change the predicted WIP interface contacts or binding energy, the hypothesis is refuted.", "starting_rank": 1, "rank_rationale": "Thr45 lies inside the EVH1 domain (E5, E6), an EVH1 domain binds proline-rich sequences (E16), and the only interaction modelling in the record shows a neighbouring EVH1 substitution disrupting a WIP contact (E15). The WASp\u2013WIP complex structure (E10) is the one experimental structure that observes residue 45. Still missing: the actual location and contacts of residue 45 (G5), so the link is inferred from the domain and not shown for this residue."}

name: record_hypothesis
arguments: {"statement": "The Thr45Met substitution destabilises the EVH1/WH1 fold, lowering folding stability and cellular WASp levels, so that little functional protein accumulates.", "mechanism_class": "stability_folding", "supports": ["E15", "E12", "E14", "E7", "E8", "E9", "E2"], "would_refute": "If residue 45 is buried in the high-confidence core of AF-P42768-F1 or 9S9X and a stability predictor gives a near-zero \u0394\u0394G for T45M, and the Met side chain fits without clashes in the model, the destabilisation mechanism is refuted.", "starting_rank": 2, "rank_rationale": "The strongest analogy is E15, where a neighbouring EVH1 substitution (L101P) severely suppresses WASp levels, which points to fold loss rather than only interface loss. The model is only moderately confident (mean pLDDT 69, E12), and the residue-level confidence is not in the record. The pathogenicity scores (E7\u2013E9) fit either mechanism. No stability or expression data for T45M exists (G4), so this ranks below the interaction hypothesis."}
